sql.hype:
WITH features(key) AS (VALUES
    ('historical.closed_1m.15m.direction'),('historical.closed_1m.30m.direction'),
    ('historical.closed_1m.1h.direction'),('historical.closed_1m.4h.direction'),
    ('historical.closed_1m.12h.direction'),('historical.closed_1m.24h.direction'),
    ('historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime'),('historical.closed_1m.1h.relative_strength_pct'),
    ('historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment')
), samples AS (
    SELECT n.*,o.payload AS old_payload
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples n
    LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples o ON o.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context'
        AND o.consumer_version=n.consumer_version AND o.snapshot_set_id=n.snapshot_set_id
        AND o.symbol=n.symbol AND o.status='READY'
    WHERE n.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context' AND n.symbol='HYPE' AND n.status='READY'
), cells AS (
    SELECT s.snapshot_set_id,b.base,f.key,
        s.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'features'->f.key AS value,
        s.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'unavailable_features'->f.key AS reasons
    FROM samples s CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base) CROSS JOIN features f
), cvd AS (
    SELECT s.snapshot_set_id,b.base,s.old_payload IS NOT NULL AS has_previous,
        s.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'features'->'spot_cvd.aligned_score' AS value,
        s.old_payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'features'->'spot_cvd.aligned_score' AS old_value,
        s.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'unavailable_features'->'spot_cvd.aligned_score' AS reasons,
        s.old_payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'unavailable_features'->'spot_cvd.aligned_score' AS old_reasons
    FROM samples s CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base)
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'hype_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM samples),
    'new_own_feature_cells_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM cells),
    'incorrectly_known_new_own_features',(SELECT count(*) FROM cells WHERE value IS NOT NULL),
    'incorrect_missing_reasons',(SELECT count(*) FROM cells WHERE reasons IS DISTINCT FROM '["HYPE_SPOT_LOOKBACK_NOT_ENABLED_FOR_WATCH"]'::jsonb),
    'own_route_contract_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM samples WHERE payload#>>'{asset_context_provenance,price_route}' IS NOT NULL
        OR payload#>>'{asset_context_provenance,route_validation_reason}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'HYPE_SPOT_LOOKBACK_NOT_ENABLED_FOR_WATCH'),
    'spot_cvd_known_cells',(SELECT count(*) FROM cvd WHERE value IS NOT NULL),
    'spot_cvd_changed_cells',(SELECT count(*) FROM cvd WHERE has_previous AND (value IS DISTINCT FROM old_value OR reasons IS DISTINCT FROM old_reasons)),
    'non_perp_hype_measurements',(SELECT count(*) FROM research_watch_scan_measurements WHERE measurement_version='watch-scan-measurements-v1'
        AND symbol='HYPE' AND price_route IS DISTINCT FROM 'HYPERLIQUID_HYPE_PERP_TRADE_1M')) AS verification;
sql.parity:
WITH old AS (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context' AND status='READY'
), new AS (
    SELECT s.*,m.decision_map FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_object_agg((value->>'candidate_key')||'|'||(value->>'base_direction'),value) AS decision_map
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.payload->'evaluations')) m
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context' AND status='READY'
), pairs AS (
    SELECT o.consumer_version,o.snapshot_set_id,o.symbol,o.payload AS old_payload,
        n.payload AS new_payload,n.decision_map,n.snapshot_set_id IS NOT NULL AS new_present
    FROM old o LEFT JOIN new n USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol)
), decisions AS (
    SELECT p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol,o.value AS old_decision,p.decision_map->((o.value->>'candidate_key')||'|'||(o.value->>'base_direction')) AS new_decision
    FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.old_payload->'evaluations') o(value)
), prior_features AS (
    SELECT p.snapshot_set_id,p.symbol,b.base,k.key,k.value AS old_value,
        p.new_payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->block.kind->k.key AS new_value
    FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base)
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES('features'),('unavailable_features')) block(kind)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(p.old_payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->block.kind) k
), source_binding AS (
    SELECT n.*,i.bundle_sha256,i.parent_payload_sha256,
        n.payload->'asset_context_provenance' AS own_context
    FROM new n JOIN research_watch_scan_intakes i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
), shared AS (
    SELECT snapshot_set_id,count(DISTINCT payload->'btc_context_provenance') AS btc_contexts
    FROM new GROUP BY snapshot_set_id
), catalog AS (
    SELECT o.candidate_key AS old_key,n.candidate_key AS new_key,o.definition AS old_definition,
        n.definition AS new_definition,o.definition_sha256 AS old_hash,n.definition_sha256 AS new_hash,
        o.orientation AS old_orientation,n.orientation AS new_orientation,
        o.supported AS old_supported,n.supported AS new_supported
    FROM (SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context') o
    FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context') n
    USING(candidate_key)
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'old_ready_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM old),
    'old_samples_missing_v4',(SELECT count(*) FROM pairs WHERE NOT new_present),
    'v4_samples_without_v3',(SELECT count(*) FROM new n LEFT JOIN old o USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol) WHERE o.snapshot_set_id IS NULL),
    'old_decisions_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM decisions),
    'old_decision_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM decisions WHERE old_decision IS DISTINCT FROM new_decision),
    'old_feature_or_missing_reason_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM prior_features WHERE old_value IS DISTINCT FROM new_value),
    'frozen_btc_context_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM pairs WHERE old_payload->'btc_context_provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM new_payload->'btc_context_provenance'),
    'split_btc_context_scans',(SELECT count(*) FROM shared WHERE btc_contexts<>1),
    'source_or_context_binding_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM source_binding WHERE
        payload->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256 OR payload->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
        OR own_context->>'symbol' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol
        OR own_context->>'consumer_version' IS DISTINCT FROM consumer_version
        OR (own_context->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot_set_id
        OR own_context->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256
        OR own_context->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256
        OR (own_context->>'usable_from_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
        OR (own_context->>'cutoff_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM date_trunc('minute',usable_from_utc)
        OR own_context->>'btc_context_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM payload#>>'{btc_context_provenance,context_sha256}'),
    'btc_own_1h_4h_window_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM new CROSS JOIN (VALUES('1h'),('4h')) w(name)
        WHERE symbol='BTC' AND payload->'asset_context_provenance'->'windows'->w.name
            IS DISTINCT FROM payload->'btc_context_provenance'->'windows'->w.name),
    'catalog_definition_or_orientation_mismatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog WHERE old_key IS NULL OR new_key IS NULL
        OR old_definition IS DISTINCT FROM new_definition OR old_hash IS DISTINCT FROM new_hash OR old_orientation IS DISTINCT FROM new_orientation),
    'previously_supported_now_unsupported',(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog WHERE old_supported AND NOT new_supported),
    'newly_supported_definitions',(SELECT count(*) FROM catalog WHERE NOT old_supported AND new_supported),
    'decision_mismatch_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT * FROM decisions WHERE old_decision IS DISTINCT FROM new_decision LIMIT 10) x)) AS verification;
sql.raw-price:
-- Independent arithmetic from immutable raw Spot bars. No evaluator helpers.
-- A frozen missing window may now have a complete archive; report that without
-- treating retrospective enrichment as permission to rewrite the frozen window.
WITH samples AS (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol,usable_from_utc,payload,
        payload->'asset_context_provenance' AS own_context,
        payload->'btc_context_provenance' AS btc_context
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context' AND status='READY'
        AND symbol IN ('BTC','ETH','SOL','BNB','XRP','DOGE','ZEC')
), windows AS (
    SELECT s.*,w.name,w.minutes,date_trunc('minute',s.usable_from_utc) AS boundary,
        date_trunc('minute',s.usable_from_utc)-w.minutes*interval '1 minute' AS start_utc,
        s.own_context->'windows'->w.name AS proof
    FROM samples s CROSS JOIN (VALUES('15m',15),('30m',30),('1h',60),('4h',240),('12h',720),('24h',1440)) w(name,minutes)
), prices AS (
    SELECT w.*,p.*,
        p.n=w.minutes AND p.first_minute=w.start_utc AND p.last_minute=w.boundary-interval '1 minute'
            AND p.valid_minutes IS TRUE AS raw_complete,
        100.0*(p.last_close/NULLIF(p.first_open,0)-1.0) AS raw_return_pct,
        100.0*(p.highest-p.lowest)/NULLIF(p.first_open,0) AS raw_range_pct
    FROM windows w LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(*) AS n,min(b.open_time_utc) AS first_minute,max(b.open_time_utc) AS last_minute,
            bool_and(b.open_time_utc=date_trunc('minute',b.open_time_utc)
                AND b.close_time_utc=b.open_time_utc+interval '1 minute'-interval '1 millisecond'
                AND b.close_time_utc<w.boundary AND b.low>0 AND b.high<'Infinity'::float8
                AND b.low<=least(b.open,b.close) AND b.high>=greatest(b.open,b.close)) AS valid_minutes,
            (array_agg(b.open ORDER BY b.open_time_utc))[1] AS first_open,
            (array_agg(b.close ORDER BY b.open_time_utc DESC))[1] AS last_close,
            max(b.high) AS highest,min(b.low) AS lowest
        FROM research_price_archive_bars b
        WHERE b.route='BINANCE_SPOT_TRADE_1M' AND b.symbol=w.symbol
            AND b.open_time_utc>=w.start_utc AND b.open_time_utc<w.boundary
    ) p ON true
), raw AS (
    SELECT p.*,
        CASE WHEN raw_return_pct>0 THEN 'UP' WHEN raw_return_pct<0 THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'FLAT' END AS raw_direction,
        CASE WHEN raw_range_pct<=0 OR abs(raw_return_pct)/NULLIF(raw_range_pct,0)<0.5 THEN 'RANGE'
             WHEN raw_return_pct>0 THEN 'UP' WHEN raw_return_pct<0 THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'RANGE' END AS raw_regime,
        proof->>'status'='READY' AS frozen_ready
    FROM prices p
), checks AS (
    SELECT r.*,
        frozen_ready AND (
            raw_complete IS NOT TRUE
            OR (proof->>'lookback_minutes')::int IS DISTINCT FROM minutes
            OR (proof->>'path_samples')::int IS DISTINCT FROM minutes
            OR proof->>'path_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
            OR (proof->>'window_start_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM start_utc
            OR (proof->>'window_end_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM boundary-interval '1 millisecond'
            OR (proof->>'event_time_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
            OR proof#>>'{source,symbol}' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol
            OR proof#>>'{source,exchange}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'binance'
            OR proof#>>'{source,market}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'spot'
            OR proof#>>'{source,pair}' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol||'USDT'
            OR proof#>>'{source,interval}' IS DISTINCT FROM '1m'
            OR (proof->>'path_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
            OR proof->>'return_pct' IS NULL OR abs((proof->>'return_pct')::float8-raw_return_pct)>1e-9
            OR proof->>'range_pct' IS NULL OR abs((proof->>'range_pct')::float8-raw_range_pct)>1e-9
            OR proof->>'direction' IS DISTINCT FROM raw_direction
            OR proof->>'market_regime' IS DISTINCT FROM raw_regime
        ) AS window_error
    FROM raw r
), direction_cells AS (
    SELECT c.*,b.base,
        c.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'features' AS feature_values,
        c.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'unavailable_features' AS missing
    FROM checks c CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base)
), feature_checks AS (
    SELECT d.*,
        CASE WHEN frozen_ready THEN feature_values->>('historical.closed_1m.'||name||'.direction') IS DISTINCT FROM raw_direction
            ELSE feature_values ? ('historical.closed_1m.'||name||'.direction')
                OR NOT (missing ? ('historical.closed_1m.'||name||'.direction')) END AS direction_error,
        CASE WHEN name<>'4h' THEN false WHEN frozen_ready
            THEN feature_values->>'historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime' IS DISTINCT FROM raw_regime
            ELSE feature_values ? 'historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime'
                OR NOT (missing ? 'historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime') END AS regime_error,
        CASE WHEN name<>'1h' THEN false WHEN frozen_ready
            THEN feature_values->>'historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment' IS DISTINCT FROM
                CASE WHEN raw_direction='FLAT' THEN 'FLAT'
                    WHEN (raw_direction='UP')=(base='LONG') THEN 'SUPPORTS' ELSE 'OPPOSES' END
            ELSE feature_values ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment'
                OR NOT (missing ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment') END AS alignment_error
    FROM direction_cells d
), relative_cells AS (
    SELECT d.snapshot_set_id,d.symbol,d.base,d.frozen_ready,
        d.btc_context->'features' ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction' AS frozen_btc_ready,
        btc.raw_complete AS btc_raw_complete,
        d.raw_return_pct-btc.raw_return_pct AS expected_relative,
        d.feature_values->>'historical.closed_1m.1h.relative_strength_pct' AS actual_relative,
        d.missing ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.relative_strength_pct' AS has_missing_reason
    FROM direction_cells d LEFT JOIN raw btc ON btc.consumer_version=d.consumer_version
        AND btc.snapshot_set_id=d.snapshot_set_id AND btc.symbol='BTC' AND btc.name='1h'
    WHERE d.name='1h'
), relative_checks AS (
    SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN frozen_ready AND frozen_btc_ready THEN
        btc_raw_complete IS NOT TRUE OR expected_relative IS NULL OR actual_relative IS NULL
            OR abs(actual_relative::float8-expected_relative)>1e-9
        ELSE actual_relative IS NOT NULL OR NOT has_missing_reason END AS relative_error
    FROM relative_cells r
), summary AS (
    SELECT name,count(*) AS windows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE frozen_ready) AS frozen_ready,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE raw_complete) AS raw_complete,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT frozen_ready AND raw_complete) AS frozen_missing_now_available,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE window_error) AS window_errors
    FROM checks GROUP BY name
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'spot_coin_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM samples),
    'raw_window_checks',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks),
    'window_proof_or_raw_price_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE window_error),
    'direction_cells_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks),
    'direction_feature_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks WHERE direction_error),
    'regime_feature_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks WHERE regime_error),
    'alignment_feature_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks WHERE alignment_error),
    'relative_strength_cells_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM relative_checks),
    'relative_strength_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM relative_checks WHERE relative_error),
    'btc_known_nonzero_self_relative',(SELECT count(*) FROM relative_checks WHERE symbol='BTC' AND actual_relative IS NOT NULL AND actual_relative::float8<>0),
    'by_window',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY name) FROM summary s),
    'window_error_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT snapshot_set_id,symbol,name,n,raw_complete,proof->>'status' AS frozen_status FROM checks WHERE window_error LIMIT 10) e),
    'feature_error_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT snapshot_set_id,symbol,name,base,direction_error,regime_error,alignment_error FROM feature_checks WHERE direction_error OR regime_error OR alignment_error LIMIT 10) e),
    'relative_error_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT * FROM relative_checks WHERE relative_error LIMIT 10) e)
) AS verification;
sql.state:
WITH current_samples AS (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context'
), accepted AS (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_intakes
    WHERE consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND intake_status='ACCEPTED'
), incomplete AS (
    SELECT i.snapshot_set_id,coin.symbol,s.status
    FROM accepted i CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['BTC','ETH','SOL','BNB','XRP','DOGE','ZEC','HYPE']) coin(symbol)
    LEFT JOIN current_samples s ON s.consumer_version=i.consumer_version
        AND s.snapshot_set_id=i.snapshot_set_id AND s.symbol=coin.symbol
    WHERE s.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY'
), catalogs AS (
    SELECT evaluation_version,count(*) AS definitions,count(*) FILTER(WHERE supported) AS supported,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT supported) AS unsupported
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog GROUP BY evaluation_version
), evals AS (
    SELECT evaluation_version,count(*) AS decisions,count(DISTINCT candidate_key) AS candidates,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE match_status='MATCH') AS matched,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE match_status='NO_MATCH') AS controls,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE match_status='UNKNOWN') AS unknown,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifies_as_prospective_formula_evidence) AS prospective
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_evaluations GROUP BY evaluation_version
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'checked_at_utc',clock_timestamp(),
    'runtime',(SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM research_watch_scan_formula_runtime r WHERE singleton=true),
    'catalogs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY evaluation_version) FROM catalogs c),
    'accepted_scans',(SELECT count(*) FROM accepted),
    'expected_coin_samples',(SELECT count(*)*8 FROM accepted),
    'missing_or_pending_coin_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM incomplete),
    'v4_samples',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'ready',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='READY'),
        'waiting',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='WAITING'),'errors',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ERROR'),
        'scans',count(DISTINCT snapshot_set_id),'symbols',count(DISTINCT symbol),
        'bad_decision_coverage',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='READY' AND jsonb_array_length(payload->'evaluations') IS DISTINCT FROM 316),
        'latest_usable_utc',max(usable_from_utc)) FROM current_samples),
    'current_evaluations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM evals e),
    'independent_live_btc_waves',(SELECT count(DISTINCT m.payload#>>'{membership,btc_parent_movement_id}')
        FROM research_watch_scan_measurements m JOIN accepted i USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
        WHERE m.measurement_version='watch-scan-measurements-v1'
            AND m.payload#>>'{membership,membership_status}'='LIVE'
            AND m.payload#>>'{membership,episode_policy_version}'='btc-parent-close-reversal-200bps-v1'),
    'version_cursor',(SELECT to_jsonb(st) FROM research_watch_scan_formula_state st
        WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context')) AS verification;
sql.new_scan_raw:
-- Independent arithmetic from immutable raw Spot bars. No evaluator helpers.
-- A frozen missing window may now have a complete archive; report that without
-- treating retrospective enrichment as permission to rewrite the frozen window.
WITH samples AS (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,symbol,usable_from_utc,payload,
        payload->'asset_context_provenance' AS own_context,
        payload->'btc_context_provenance' AS btc_context
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples
    WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v4-asset-context' AND status='READY'
        AND symbol IN ('BTC','ETH','SOL','BNB','XRP','DOGE','ZEC')
        AND snapshot_set_id NOT IN (SELECT snapshot_set_id FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context' AND status='READY')
), windows AS (
    SELECT s.*,w.name,w.minutes,date_trunc('minute',s.usable_from_utc) AS boundary,
        date_trunc('minute',s.usable_from_utc)-w.minutes*interval '1 minute' AS start_utc,
        s.own_context->'windows'->w.name AS proof
    FROM samples s CROSS JOIN (VALUES('15m',15),('30m',30),('1h',60),('4h',240),('12h',720),('24h',1440)) w(name,minutes)
), prices AS (
    SELECT w.*,p.*,
        p.n=w.minutes AND p.first_minute=w.start_utc AND p.last_minute=w.boundary-interval '1 minute'
            AND p.valid_minutes IS TRUE AS raw_complete,
        100.0*(p.last_close/NULLIF(p.first_open,0)-1.0) AS raw_return_pct,
        100.0*(p.highest-p.lowest)/NULLIF(p.first_open,0) AS raw_range_pct
    FROM windows w LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(*) AS n,min(b.open_time_utc) AS first_minute,max(b.open_time_utc) AS last_minute,
            bool_and(b.open_time_utc=date_trunc('minute',b.open_time_utc)
                AND b.close_time_utc=b.open_time_utc+interval '1 minute'-interval '1 millisecond'
                AND b.close_time_utc<w.boundary AND b.low>0 AND b.high<'Infinity'::float8
                AND b.low<=least(b.open,b.close) AND b.high>=greatest(b.open,b.close)) AS valid_minutes,
            (array_agg(b.open ORDER BY b.open_time_utc))[1] AS first_open,
            (array_agg(b.close ORDER BY b.open_time_utc DESC))[1] AS last_close,
            max(b.high) AS highest,min(b.low) AS lowest
        FROM research_price_archive_bars b
        WHERE b.route='BINANCE_SPOT_TRADE_1M' AND b.symbol=w.symbol
            AND b.open_time_utc>=w.start_utc AND b.open_time_utc<w.boundary
    ) p ON true
), raw AS (
    SELECT p.*,
        CASE WHEN raw_return_pct>0 THEN 'UP' WHEN raw_return_pct<0 THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'FLAT' END AS raw_direction,
        CASE WHEN raw_range_pct<=0 OR abs(raw_return_pct)/NULLIF(raw_range_pct,0)<0.5 THEN 'RANGE'
             WHEN raw_return_pct>0 THEN 'UP' WHEN raw_return_pct<0 THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'RANGE' END AS raw_regime,
        proof->>'status'='READY' AS frozen_ready
    FROM prices p
), checks AS (
    SELECT r.*,
        frozen_ready AND (
            raw_complete IS NOT TRUE
            OR (proof->>'lookback_minutes')::int IS DISTINCT FROM minutes
            OR (proof->>'path_samples')::int IS DISTINCT FROM minutes
            OR proof->>'path_complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
            OR (proof->>'window_start_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM start_utc
            OR (proof->>'window_end_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM boundary-interval '1 millisecond'
            OR (proof->>'event_time_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
            OR proof#>>'{source,symbol}' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol
            OR proof#>>'{source,exchange}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'binance'
            OR proof#>>'{source,market}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'spot'
            OR proof#>>'{source,pair}' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol||'USDT'
            OR proof#>>'{source,interval}' IS DISTINCT FROM '1m'
            OR (proof->>'path_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
            OR proof->>'return_pct' IS NULL OR abs((proof->>'return_pct')::float8-raw_return_pct)>1e-9
            OR proof->>'range_pct' IS NULL OR abs((proof->>'range_pct')::float8-raw_range_pct)>1e-9
            OR proof->>'direction' IS DISTINCT FROM raw_direction
            OR proof->>'market_regime' IS DISTINCT FROM raw_regime
        ) AS window_error
    FROM raw r
), direction_cells AS (
    SELECT c.*,b.base,
        c.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'features' AS feature_values,
        c.payload->'features_by_direction'->b.base->'unavailable_features' AS missing
    FROM checks c CROSS JOIN (VALUES('LONG'),('SHORT')) b(base)
), feature_checks AS (
    SELECT d.*,
        CASE WHEN frozen_ready THEN feature_values->>('historical.closed_1m.'||name||'.direction') IS DISTINCT FROM raw_direction
            ELSE feature_values ? ('historical.closed_1m.'||name||'.direction')
                OR NOT (missing ? ('historical.closed_1m.'||name||'.direction')) END AS direction_error,
        CASE WHEN name<>'4h' THEN false WHEN frozen_ready
            THEN feature_values->>'historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime' IS DISTINCT FROM raw_regime
            ELSE feature_values ? 'historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime'
                OR NOT (missing ? 'historical.closed_1m.4h.market_regime') END AS regime_error,
        CASE WHEN name<>'1h' THEN false WHEN frozen_ready
            THEN feature_values->>'historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment' IS DISTINCT FROM
                CASE WHEN raw_direction='FLAT' THEN 'FLAT'
                    WHEN (raw_direction='UP')=(base='LONG') THEN 'SUPPORTS' ELSE 'OPPOSES' END
            ELSE feature_values ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment'
                OR NOT (missing ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.alignment') END AS alignment_error
    FROM direction_cells d
), relative_cells AS (
    SELECT d.snapshot_set_id,d.symbol,d.base,d.frozen_ready,
        d.btc_context->'features' ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction' AS frozen_btc_ready,
        btc.raw_complete AS btc_raw_complete,
        d.raw_return_pct-btc.raw_return_pct AS expected_relative,
        d.feature_values->>'historical.closed_1m.1h.relative_strength_pct' AS actual_relative,
        d.missing ? 'historical.closed_1m.1h.relative_strength_pct' AS has_missing_reason
    FROM direction_cells d LEFT JOIN raw btc ON btc.consumer_version=d.consumer_version
        AND btc.snapshot_set_id=d.snapshot_set_id AND btc.symbol='BTC' AND btc.name='1h'
    WHERE d.name='1h'
), relative_checks AS (
    SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN frozen_ready AND frozen_btc_ready THEN
        btc_raw_complete IS NOT TRUE OR expected_relative IS NULL OR actual_relative IS NULL
            OR abs(actual_relative::float8-expected_relative)>1e-9
        ELSE actual_relative IS NOT NULL OR NOT has_missing_reason END AS relative_error
    FROM relative_cells r
), summary AS (
    SELECT name,count(*) AS windows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE frozen_ready) AS frozen_ready,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE raw_complete) AS raw_complete,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT frozen_ready AND raw_complete) AS frozen_missing_now_available,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE window_error) AS window_errors
    FROM checks GROUP BY name
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'spot_coin_samples',(SELECT count(*) FROM samples),
    'raw_window_checks',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks),
    'window_proof_or_raw_price_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE window_error),
    'direction_cells_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks),
    'direction_feature_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks WHERE direction_error),
    'regime_feature_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks WHERE regime_error),
    'alignment_feature_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM feature_checks WHERE alignment_error),
    'relative_strength_cells_checked',(SELECT count(*) FROM relative_checks),
    'relative_strength_errors',(SELECT count(*) FROM relative_checks WHERE relative_error),
    'btc_known_nonzero_self_relative',(SELECT count(*) FROM relative_checks WHERE symbol='BTC' AND actual_relative IS NOT NULL AND actual_relative::float8<>0),
    'by_window',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY name) FROM summary s),
    'window_error_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT snapshot_set_id,symbol,name,n,raw_complete,proof->>'status' AS frozen_status FROM checks WHERE window_error LIMIT 10) e),
    'feature_error_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT snapshot_set_id,symbol,name,base,direction_error,regime_error,alignment_error FROM feature_checks WHERE direction_error OR regime_error OR alignment_error LIMIT 10) e),
    'relative_error_examples',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT * FROM relative_checks WHERE relative_error LIMIT 10) e)
) AS verification;
